title: Blizzard Beach
description: Blizzard Beach is a water park at Walt Disney World in Florida, opened in 1995, themed as a ski resort that melted into a water park: snow-capped peaks, ski lifts, and alpine lodges surround slides, a lazy river, and a wave pool. The joke of the theme is that a freak snowstorm hit Florida, a ski resort was built, and then the snow melted, leaving the ski infrastructure to become water slides, so chair lifts carry swimmers instead of skiers and the slopes became flumes. Its signature slide, Summit Plummet, drops riders down a near-vertical chute from the top of the mountain. NEW and operating, it remains one of Disney's two water parks and a favorite for families who want big slides with a playful story.

demo.code:
SLIDES = [("Summit Plummet", 36), ("Slush Gusher", 27), ("Teamboat Springs", 20), ("Lazy river", 5)]
print("Blizzard Beach slide planner")
for name, height in SLIDES:
    print("%s: about %d m high" % (name, height))
print("Tallest slide: %s at %d m" % (max(SLIDES, key=lambda x: x[1])))
print("Slides counted: %d" % len(SLIDES))
print("Status: NEW (operating since 1995)")
demo.expected_output:
Blizzard Beach slide planner
Summit Plummet: about 36 m high
Slush Gusher: about 27 m high
Teamboat Springs: about 20 m high
Lazy river: about 5 m high
Tallest slide: Summit Plummet at 36 m
Slides counted: 4
Status: NEW (operating since 1995)

location: Bay Lake, Florida, United States (Walt Disney World area)
lands_areas: Ski village base, mountain summit, lazy river, wave pool, and family slide areas
rides: NEW: Summit Plummet and other slides, lazy river, wave pool. PAST: individual slides retired or rethemed over the years
theming: A ski resort that melted: snow, ski lifts, and alpine lodges repurposed for water
